visualCharacteristics.purpose: Hat-portal intro overlay shown on the first visit per browser session: hat / golden-ticket orbit, looping stars backdrop video and two CTAs.

contentPattern.structure: Slide rows (title paragraph | desktop + mobile images | CTA paragraph; first = hat, second = ticket), a backdrop row (link to the stars .mp4 | poster image) and a label row (swipe hint text).

usage: First-visit intro overlay on the landing page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse portal wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
